Sake is dead easy. I should probably call it "Hillbilly Sake".

Over cook some sushi rice (3 cups rice, 7 cups water), cook as normal.

When cooked, spread the rice on a baking tray to cool.

When rice is warm, sprinkle yeast (baking yeast, brewers yeast, beard yeast, whatever) and 1/4 cup of dry rice (I should mention to use a Japanese rice, you're after a specific wild yeast).

Give it a good stir, and pack it into a 1/2 gallon Balls jar. DO NOT SCREW THE LID DOWN TIGHT. You want the CO2 to be able to escape. Ideally use an airlock, but you can get away with a mostly closed lid.

Store at ~18C for about 2 weeks.

Strain your jar, and enjoy your sake.
